realm.name: employee
realm.description: Every staff member; given to everyone by default

realm.name: admin
realm.description: Runs Enterprise OS for the company: users, settings, approvals

realm.name: agent
realm.description: An AI agent (such as Claude) acting for one person, with only that person's access

realm.name: process_owner
realm.description: Reviews and approves the ontology and processes for their area

clients.name: Claude and other external AI agents

clientScopes.name: roles
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add user roles to the access token

clientScopes.name: tenant
clientScopes.description: Adds tenant_id to every token. One realm = one tenant, so the value is fixed per realm.

clientScopes.name: organization
clientScopes.description: Additional claims about the organization a subject belongs to

clientScopes.name: acr
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add acr (authentication context class reference) to the token

clientScopes.name: basic
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add all basic claims to the token

clientScopes.name: web-origins
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add allowed web origins to the access token

clientScopes.name: service_account
clientScopes.description: Specific scope for a client enabled for service accounts

clientScopes.name: entra
clientScopes.description: Adds the Microsoft user ID (entra_oid) and Microsoft tenant ID (entra_tid). For apps that match people with their Microsoft account, like Scribe.
